segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text:
The Night the Jungle Listened

Scene Atmosphere
Time: Deep night
Lighting: Moonlight cutting through dense leaves
Soundscape: Insects humming, distant howls, leaves shifting
Mood: Mysterious → tense → protective
The jungle should feel alive and aware , not just background.
The jungle breathed in whispers.
Moonlight slipped through the tangled canopy, painting silver lines across the forest floor. Leaves trembled—not from wind, but from something unseen moving through the darkness.
A branch snapp
